questions.q: Why do all five sales reports in the capstone use the standard Opportunities report type?
options: Salesforce forbids using any other report type on a dashboard
Opportunities is the only report type that supports charts
Shared fields let dashboard filters such as owner role and opportunity type apply cleanly across all components
It makes the reports load in under one second
questions.explain: Dashboard filters work best when the source reports share the filtered fields. Using one report type across the dashboard keeps that simple.

questions.q: What is the weakness of dividing open pipeline by a hard-coded $2.1M gap in the coverage formula?
options: The formula cannot return a number
Quota lives outside the report, so the gap goes stale unless someone updates it
Summary formulas cannot use division
It would double count closed deals
questions.explain: Because the quota is not stored in the report, the gap must be updated manually. Note it on the dashboard and refresh it on a schedule.

questions.q: How is the win rate calculated in the capstone?
options: A row-level formula flags won as 1 and lost as 0, then a summary formula divides the flag's sum by the record count
Sum of Amount divided by quota
Number of leads divided by number of accounts
The dashboard calculates it automatically with no formula
questions.explain: The row-level formula scores each closed opportunity, and the summary formula turns the flags into a rate: 31% in the example.

questions.q: The regional reports show West $1.6M, Central $1.3M, and East $1.0M. What should the quota gauge show if it is correct?
questions.explain: 1.6 + 1.3 + 1.0 equals $3.9M, which should match the Closed Won gauge value.

questions.q: What should you consider when choosing the dashboard's running user?
options: The running user has no effect on what viewers see
Everyone viewing the dashboard sees what the running user can see, so it must be acceptable to share that data
The running user must always be a system administrator
Only the dashboard's title depends on the running user
questions.explain: With a specified running user, viewers see that user's data. Dynamic dashboards, where available, show each viewer their own data instead.
